rules.question: Which choice in a report window's filter dropdown keeps every row?
rules.note: The two report windows once wrote the index of their dropdown's keep-everything choice as a literal 0 in their field default, their rebuild and their Clear filters branch. A literal index back in either window would reset to a real filter the day its choice list is reordered.

rules.question: Which fields of a stored summary does the library read?
rules.note: The library decides whether a refreshed lookup changed a row by comparing only the fields it reads (shows_same_as). A line that reads one of the summary fields the library ignores means a new shown field: add it to shows_same_as first, then retire it from this pattern. A line that compares two summaries field by field is a second list of the fields the library reads (apply_summary once spelled that list out). The scope is all of src/ because a row's scope names a top folder or one file; nothing outside the library reads these fields through a .summary member today, and a reader that legitimately does gets an exempt entry.
